Who it’s for

This class is for you if you want a plan, not more guesswork

  • You’re not sure whether to reach out or give it space.
  • You’ve read a lot of advice online and half of it contradicts the other half.
  • You want to understand what went wrong, so it doesn’t happen again.
  • You want a respectful plan you can feel good about, whatever the outcome.

Here’s what you’ll learn

Five things we’ll cover in 60 minutes

Why chasing usually backfires

The long texts, the late-night calls, the “can we just talk”. Why pressure tends to push people further away.

How attachment styles shape what happens next

How each person handles distance, and how to work with it instead of against it.

What to work on first: you

Why the first stretch is about getting steady yourself, so any next conversation comes from a calm place.

When reaching out makes sense, and when it doesn’t

A simple way to decide, and how to keep that first message light and respectful.

How to tell if rebuilding is right for both of you

Sometimes the best outcome is a fresh start together. Sometimes it’s moving on. You’ll leave with clarity either way.

Before you grab your seat

Can you guarantee it will work?

No, and nobody honestly can. Every relationship is two people. What you will get is a clear, respectful plan and clarity on whether rebuilding is right for you.

What if I can’t make it live?

Is this therapy?

No. It’s a coaching class with practical tools. It isn’t therapy and doesn’t replace working with a licensed professional.

Why is it free?

Because the first step should be easy. Come, take what’s useful, and decide afterwards if you want more help.

Script 1 · “The chase”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“The most common mistake people make after a breakup feels like the right thing at the time.”

Body

“It’s chasing. The long texts, the calls, the ‘can we just talk’. It comes from a good place, but pressure usually pushes people further away. What works better is slower, calmer and a lot less dramatic.”

CTA

“I’m teaching the calm way in a free 60-minute masterclass. Replay included. Tap Sign up to grab a seat.”

Shot: talking to camera, cap on, same setup as your reels.

Script 2 · “Reach out or wait?”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“Should you reach out, or give it space? Here’s how I help people decide.”

Body

“It isn’t about a magic number of days. It’s about whether you’re steady enough to have a calm conversation, and whether the other person has room for one. Get those two right and the first message gets a lot easier.”

CTA

“I break it down in my free Reconnection Masterclass. Live, 60 minutes. Tap Sign up.”

Shot: talking to camera, on-screen text “steady first” highlighted in amber.

Script 3 · “Attachment styles”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“Two people can handle the same breakup in completely opposite ways.”

Body

“One wants to talk it out right now. The other needs distance to think. That’s attachment style, and understanding it changes how you approach everything that comes next.”

CTA

“I’ll walk through it in a free live masterclass. Seats are free. Tap Sign up below.”

Shot: talking to camera, cut to a simple two-column graphic.
